what: Toronto-Dominion is one of Canada's two largest banks and runs a big retail bank on the US East Coast. It also has wealth management, insurance and a wholesale bank.
customers: Households and businesses in Canada and the US.
money: branch banking from Maine to Florida
moat: Strong share in Canada's concentrated banking market and a low-cost deposit base on both sides of the border.
risks: US regulatory limits after its money-laundering penalties
opportunities: Revenue grew about 17% last year with a 30% net margin
Its Canadian retail franchise is one of the strongest deposit businesses in the country
A dividend with an unbroken payment record stretching back more than a century
watch: US regulatory remediation progress and Canadian credit quality.
